title: Tanzania Visa: How the e-Visa Works
excerpt: Most visitors to Tanzania need a visa, which you can apply for online in advance. How the e-Visa works and what to check.
body:
Most travellers from Europe, including the Netherlands and Belgium, need a visa for Tanzania.

## Apply online

Tanzania has an official online system for e-Visa applications run by the Immigration Department. Apply only through the official government website, not through third-party sites that charge extra.

## When to apply

Apply well in advance; processing can take time. Several weeks before travel is sensible.

## What you need

- A passport valid for at least six months after arrival, with blank pages.
- A digital passport photo.
- Flight details and accommodation address.
- A payment card.

## Types

Most tourists apply for a single-entry tourist visa. If you travel to Kenya or other countries and return, check whether you need multiple entry.

## Zanzibar

Your Tanzanian visa is also valid for Zanzibar. See [Zanzibar entry requirements](/blog/zanzibar-entry-requirements/).

## Rules change

Fees, requirements and procedures can change. Always check the official site before you apply.
